* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image in the repository revision of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-vi-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Vicrul (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 2, file created 10 August 2025: “[Pilot] 2. Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Vicrul]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Vicrul]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Vicrul”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Vicrul (Errata 2)]]): PC card image in the repository revision of 12 December 2025<ref name="ht-vi-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/vicrul.gif vicrul.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e 5637ac6] (12 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Power +1 for each opponent's card out of play. Opponent may not cancel your battle destiny draws where you have Kylo or a Knight of Ren. If you just initiated a Force drain here, may place topmost Interrupt of opponent's Lost Pile out of play.”
